# Vendored libraries

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adhan.umd.min.js` | adhan-js (Batoul Apps) | 4.4.6 | MIT, see `adhan.LICENSE` | npm `adhan@4.4.6`, `lib/bundles/adhan.umd.min.js` (source map comment removed) |

To upgrade, run `npm pack adhan@<version>`, copy `lib/bundles/adhan.umd.min.js` here,
update `ADHAN_VERSION` in `js/features/prayer-times.js`, and run `npm test`.
